vb_textbox.text: Always have your fingers positioned on the S and K keys on your keyboard. Be sure keep an eye on the mushrooms collected, I alternated between the two keys when I noticed the number of mushrooms were decreasing. Be alert and focused at all times so you don't get the, "too slow" message and miss out on the mushrooms that could have been collected. I also at some points just kept to one side i.e the S which is the right side, so I had my finger on the S key and the other on the space bar. Then I switched to the left side.I noticed that the left side had higher numbers, so I focused on that side until the number of mushrooms fell to zero. Then I switched to the other side.I strongly suggest that the study be done in a quiet place with no distractions that way you are able to concentrate and work at a faster pace.Once you get the rhythm you should be able to work at a fast and steady pace. Good luck I hope this is helpful and you are able to maximize the amount of mushrooms collected.
